harbour.name: Harbour
harbour.mood: Warm and local. Olive and brick on cool paper, a characterful grotesque.

coast.name: Coast
coast.mood: Clean and trustworthy. White, deep navy and one hi-vis yellow.

calm.name: Calm
calm.mood: Quiet and premium. Light type at large sizes, deep teal on cool stone.

ink.name: Ink
ink.mood: Editorial and confident. Black and white, square corners, one electric blue.

forest.name: Forest
forest.mood: Grounded and natural. Deep green and bone with an amber accent, soft pill shapes.

night.name: Night
night.mood: Moody and modern. Dark all the time, warm coral accent. Bars, barbers, tattoo, late trading.

sun.name: Sun
sun.mood: Bright and playful. Hot pink on white, a wide rounded display face, big soft corners.

riso.name: Riso
riso.mood: Poster print. Cream paper, navy ink, tomato red, a big serif cut up across lines, print grain.
riso.css: body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.26;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='240' height='240'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .45  0 0 0 0 .4  0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 .6 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}.hero{isolation:isolate}.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7.8rem);line-height:.88;max-width:11ch}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4.4rem);line-height:.94}.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}.hero-img,.shot img,.photo img,.tile-photo img,.menu-photo img,.portrait img,.ph img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)}.hero::before{right:-7vw;top:-9vw;width:30vw;height:30vw;max-width:420px;max-height:420px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}

halftone.name: Halftone
halftone.mood: Loud print. Paper, halftone blue photos, hot pink condensed type set at a tilt.
halftone.css: body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.26;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='240' height='240'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .45  0 0 0 0 .4  0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 .6 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}.hero{isolation:isolate}.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7.8rem);line-height:.88;max-width:11ch}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4.4rem);line-height:.94}.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}.hero-img,.shot img,.photo img,.tile-photo img,.menu-photo img,.portrait img,.ph img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)}.hero h1{transform:rotate(-4deg);transform-origin:left bottom;line-height:.86}.hero-img,.shot img,.photo img,.tile-photo img,.menu-photo img,.portrait img,.ph img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.35) sepia(1) hue-rotate(188deg) saturate(2.4) brightness(.92)}.hero::before{left:-30px;bottom:-30px;width:180px;height:180px;background:var(--accent);transform:rotate(-7deg)}

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.mood: Flower-shop poster. Butter ground, aubergine ink, orange flowers, heavy italic type.
bloom.css: body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.26;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='240' height='240'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .45  0 0 0 0 .4  0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 .6 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}.hero{isolation:isolate}.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7.8rem);line-height:.88;max-width:11ch}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4.4rem);line-height:.94}.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}.hero-img,.shot img,.photo img,.tile-photo img,.menu-photo img,.portrait img,.ph img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)}h1,.h2{font-style:italic}.hero::before{right:-40px;top:40px;width:260px;height:260px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 34%,#d8683b 0 21%,transparent 22%),radial-gradient(circle at 66% 30%,#d8683b 0 21%,transparent 22%),radial-gradient(circle at 74% 64%,#d8683b 0 21%,transparent 22%),radial-gradient(circle at 42% 72%,#d8683b 0 21%,transparent 22%),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#d8683b 0 22%,transparent 23%)}

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.mood: Seasonal poster. Warm cream, brick and gold, very light display type, flat leaf shapes.
autumn.css: body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.26;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='240' height='240'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .45  0 0 0 0 .4  0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 .6 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}.hero{isolation:isolate}.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7.8rem);line-height:.88;max-width:11ch}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4.4rem);line-height:.94}.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}.hero-img,.shot img,.photo img,.tile-photo img,.menu-photo img,.portrait img,.ph img{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)}.hero::before{left:-60px;bottom:-60px;width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:0 100% 0 100%;background:#e8a23f;transform:rotate(-18deg);opacity:.95}

paddy.name: Paddy
paddy.mood: Restaurant. Cream and rice-paddy green, soft pink, a fine serif with an italic second line.

orchid.name: Orchid
orchid.mood: Restaurant. Blush and plum, bright pink, a soft chunky serif wordmark with tall condensed capitals.

ember.name: Ember
ember.mood: Fine dining. Near-black and candle gold, a fine serif, thin gold rules, quiet and expensive.
ember.css: .top .nav,.top .btn,.btn{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500}.btn-primary,.btn-accent{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}.btn-primary:hover,.btn-accent:hover{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);filter:none}.top .btn-light{background:transparent;color:#efe6d2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(239 230 210 / .5)}.mark{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}.hero::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(8 6 4 / .7),rgb(8 6 4 / .35) 45%,rgb(8 6 4 / .85))}.hero h1{font-weight:500;line-height:1.02}.hero h1 em{color:var(--accent)}.h2{font-weight:500}.h2::after{content:"";display:block;width:3.5rem;height:1px;margin-top:1.1rem;background:var(--accent)}.hero-wordmark .wordmark{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;text-shadow:none}.hero-wordmark .hero h1{font-family:"Jost",sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.6vw,1.15rem);letter-spacing:.32em}.cat h3{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;font-family:"Jost",sans-serif;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600}.item+.item{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.item b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}.frame,.menu-photo{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line);padding:.6rem;background:transparent}.frame img,.menu-photo img{border-radius:0}.hero-centre .hero-dish{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent),0 0 0 10px rgb(15 13 11 / .9),0 0 0 11px var(--accent),0 40px 70px -25px #000}.hero-cards li{background:rgb(15 13 11 / .85);color:#efe6d2;border:1px solid rgb(201 162 95 / .45)}.hero-stats li:last-child{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}.hero-wordmark .hero h1{max-width:44ch;line-height:1.6}@media (max-width:760px){.top .btn{letter-spacing:.02em;padding:.55rem .8rem}.brand{font-size:1rem}}

checker.name: Checker
checker.mood: Street-food poster. Cobalt blue, white and yellow, tall condensed capitals, a checkerboard strip.
checker.css: h1,.h2,.wordmark,.cat h3,.addr{text-transform:uppercase}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.4rem,9vw,8rem);line-height:.86;max-width:12ch;text-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--accent);color:#fff}.hero-split .hero h1{text-shadow:5px 5px 0 #0d1b66}.hero-split .hero{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}.hero-split .hero p{color:var(--muted)}.hero-split .btn-glass{color:#fff;border-color:rgb(255 255 255 / .45)}.hero-split .top{color:#fff}.hero-split .top .btn-light{background:#fff;color:#10204f}.hero-split .hero-img{border-radius:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 8px #fff}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,4.6rem);line-height:.92}.h2,.cat h3{color:var(--accent)}.btn{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.facts{position:relative;padding-top:30px;border:0;background:var(--surface)}.facts::before,.menu::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:30px;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#fff 0 25%,transparent 0 50%) 0 0/30px 30px}.menu{position:relative;padding-top:calc(clamp(4rem,9vw,7rem) + 30px)}.frame,.menu-photo{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #fff;transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}.item+.item{border-top:2px dotted var(--line)}.price{color:var(--accent)}.hours li.is-today{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}.hours li.is-today .d::after{color:var(--on-accent)}.hero-wordmark .wordmark{color:var(--accent);text-shadow:6px 6px 0 #10204f}.special .h2,.special .kicker{color:var(--on-accent)}.special-price{background:#10204f;color:var(--accent)}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);text-shadow:5px 5px 0 #0d1b66}.hero-split .hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,6vw,5.6rem);line-height:.9}@media (max-width:760px){.top .btn{letter-spacing:0;font-size:.82rem;padding:.55rem .85rem}}

trattoria.name: Trattoria
trattoria.mood: Italian trattoria. Cream, tomato red and olive, a round serif with italic lines, a striped awning.
trattoria.css: .hero h1 em,.h2 em{font-family:"Newsreader",serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400}.hero-centre .hero h1 em{color:#ffd9b8}.menu{position:relative;padding-top:calc(clamp(4rem,9vw,7rem) + 30px)}.menu::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:36px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent) 0 36px,var(--card) 36px 72px);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) top/100% 18px no-repeat,radial-gradient(18px at 18px 18px,#000 98%,#0000) 0 0/36px 36px repeat-x;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) top/100% 18px no-repeat,radial-gradient(18px at 18px 18px,#000 98%,#0000) 0 0/36px 36px repeat-x}.cat h3{font-family:"Newsreader",serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.6rem}.item+.item{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}.price{color:var(--accent)}.hero-split .hero-img{border-radius:999px 999px 0 0;margin:2rem 2rem 0 0;height:calc(100% - 2rem)}.hero-wordmark .wordmark{color:#fff3e0;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:none}.hero-wordmark .hero h1{font-family:"Newsreader",serif;font-style:italic;text-transform:none;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem);letter-spacing:0}.hero-wordmark .hero::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgb(40 14 6 / .6),rgb(40 14 6 / .35) 65%,rgb(40 14 6 / .55))}.mark{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}

cantina.name: Cantina
cantina.mood: Bright and loud. Warm cream, chilli orange, lime green and pink, chunky round capitals, a row of party flags.
cantina.css: .hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:5rem;z-index:2;height:42px;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#ff5a1f 0 46px,#1f8a4c 46px 92px,#ff3d8b 92px 138px,#ffc93c 138px 184px);-webkit-mask:conic-gradient(from -40deg at 50% 100%,#000 80deg,#0000 0) 0 0/46px 100%;mask:conic-gradient(from -40deg at 50% 100%,#000 80deg,#0000 0) 0 0/46px 100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / .25))}.hero::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(30 18 8 / .55),rgb(30 18 8 / .2) 40%,rgb(30 18 8 / .7))}h1,.h2,.wordmark,.cat h3{text-transform:uppercase}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,5rem);line-height:.92;max-width:12ch}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#ffc93c}.h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.8rem);line-height:.95}.cat h3{color:var(--accent-2)}.btn-primary{box-shadow:0 4px 0 #1e1208}.price{background:#ffc93c;color:#1e1208;padding:.05rem .55rem;border-radius:999px;height:fit-content}.frame,.menu-photo{transform:rotate(2deg);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--card),0 0 0 11px var(--accent)}.hero-wordmark .wordmark{color:#ffc93c;text-shadow:5px 5px 0 #ff3d8b}.hero-wordmark .hero h1{color:#fff}.facts{background:var(--accent-2);color:#fff;border:0}.facts .i{color:#ffc93c}

umami.name: Umami
umami.mood: Black, rice-paper white and one red sun. Very wide heavy capitals, clean lines, nothing extra.

blush.name: Blush
blush.mood: Beauty editorial. Powder pink and deep rose, a high-contrast serif with italic words, arched photos.
blush.css: h1 em,.h2 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:400}.hero h1{line-height:1.02}.hero h1 em,.h2 em{color:var(--accent)}.btn,.btn-accent,.btn-primary{letter-spacing:.02em}.hero-img,.photo img,.portrait img,.ph img,.shot img,.frame img{object-position:center 30%}.h2{font-weight:500}.kicker{color:var(--accent)}.top .nav a,.top .brand{letter-spacing:.02em}.hero-full .hero h1{text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / .45)}.hero-full .hero::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(40 15 20 / .6),rgb(40 15 20 / .15) 65%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(40 15 20 / .3),transparent 30%)}.hero-full .hero h1{font-weight:600}

sage.name: Sage
sage.mood: Apothecary calm. Sage green, stone and oat, a large soft serif set in lower case, square photos, lots of air.

iron.name: Iron
iron.mood: Gym floor. Black, acid lime, heavy italic condensed capitals, diagonal hazard stripes.

pomade.name: Pomade
pomade.mood: Old-school barbershop. Oxblood, cream and brass, a heavy slab serif, a striped pole.

mint.name: Mint
mint.mood: Friendly clinic. Clean white, fresh mint and deep navy, a round soft sans, blob shapes.

garage.name: Garage
garage.mood: Workshop. Hazard yellow and black, stencil capitals, hazard-tape strips, steel grey.

terrace.name: Terrace
terrace.mood: Property. Warm white, deep navy and brass, a classical serif in spaced capitals, fine frames.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.mood: Accounting. Ledger paper with ruled lines, bottle green ink, a sturdy serif and monospaced figures.
ledger.css: body{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 31px,rgb(19 78 58 / .07) 31px 32px)}.num,.price,.fee{font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace}.hero h1 em,.h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent-2)}.h2{border-left:4px solid var(--accent-2);padding-left:1rem}

veil.name: Veil
veil.mood: Weddings. Ivory and warm taupe, a tall elegant display face with script flourishes, soft and airy.

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.mood: Tutoring. Blackboard green, chalk white and a yellow highlighter, handwritten notes beside a clean sans.

crayon.name: Crayon
crayon.mood: Early learning. Warm cream with sunny yellow, sky blue and coral, a round bubbly face, wavy edges.

paws.name: Paws
paws.mood: Vet clinic. Calm teal and warm sand, a friendly geometric sans, rounded cards and a paw-print trail.

fresh.name: Fresh
fresh.mood: Cleaning. Bright white, clean electric blue and a splash of lemon, bold rounded sans, soap-bubble circles.

cellar.name: Cellar
cellar.mood: Cellar door. Burgundy and parchment, classical inscribed capitals and an old-style serif, quiet gold rules.
